review_evidence: README identifies lean-url as an implementation of the WHATWG URL parsing/API specification in Lean, with current placeholders for portions such as IDNA.

Across 17 primary files the source has 174 declaration-style implementation items but only one actual theorem declaration (`Char.c0ControlOrSpace_eq`); apparent grep hits for `example.com` are data/text rather than proposition proofs.
The remaining modules implement URL parser/state/API behavior and test/examples, without an independently proved conformance theorem or formal semantics of the WHATWG algorithm.

source_action.content_invariant: The 17 primary files are URL parser/API implementation, state-machine/data utilities and examples. The sole substantive theorem is a small character predicate fact; there is no independent proved URL specification, parser-correctness development or mathematical theorem corpus, so retirement is content-lossless for the formalization index.
